footer.description: Wellness Destination Development & Advisory in Vietnam.

story.heading: Our Story
story.body: Vietnam Wellness Retreat began with a simple question: what makes a destination truly healing? We believe the answer lies not in amenities, but in how a space is conceived through vision, nurtured through strategy, and told through experience. We partner with investors and stakeholders to build sustainable Wellness destinations that create lasting value for people, communities and nature.

items.desc: Shaping the concept, planning and design of a complete Wellness destination from day one.

items.title: Hospitality & Business Consulting
items.desc: Advising on operating models, business strategy and world-class hospitality experiences.

philosophy.heading: Our Wellness Philosophy
philosophy.quoteEn: Vision defines the destination. Strategy creates the legacy.
philosophy.quoteVi: Vision defines the destination. Strategy creates the legacy.
philosophy.body: We see Wellness not as a single item on a project checklist, but as a development strategy — where people, nature, culture and experience connect into one unified system of value. Before design, we talk about vision. Before operations, we talk about strategy. Before success, we talk about legacy.

wellnessTourism.heading: Wellness Tourism — A Global Growth Trend
wellnessTourism.body: Travel is changing. Today's travelers are looking for more than a place to rest — they want to return home as a healthier, more balanced version of themselves. That is why Wellness Tourism has become one of the fastest-growing segments in global travel.

about.title: About Us
about.intro: Vietnam Wellness Retreat is a pioneer in Wellness Destination Development in Vietnam, partnering with investors, resorts and businesses to build world-class wellness destinations.
about.vision: To become the leading partner in developing the Wellness Destination ecosystem in Vietnam and Southeast Asia.
about.mission: To create spaces that help people live healthier, happier lives and connect more deeply with themselves.
about.founderIntro: With deep experience in Wellness destination consulting, Nguyen Thi Thu Trang partners with investors from early concept positioning through to successful operation.

faq.q: Does Vietnam Wellness Retreat advise on early-stage projects?
faq.a: Yes. We partner from initial concept positioning and market research through to operation.

faq.q: Does the service include architectural design?
faq.a: We focus on strategy, Wellness concept and experience; for architecture, we collaborate with specialist design partners.

faq.q: Where does Vietnam Wellness Retreat operate?
faq.a: We are based in Hanoi and partner with projects across Vietnam.
